title: My town
instructions: Kemal yaşadığı kasabayı eski şehriyle karşılaştırıyor. Uzun bir metin; "-er / more / than" karşılaştırmalarına dikkat et.

script.speaker: kemal
script.text: Two years ago, I moved from Istanbul to a small town near the sea.

script.speaker: kemal
script.text: My town is much quieter than Istanbul, and the air is cleaner.

script.speaker: kemal
script.text: There aren't many shops, but there is a nice market every Wednesday.

script.speaker: kemal
script.text: There is one cinema, a library and a beautiful park.

script.speaker: kemal
script.text: Houses here are cheaper, so now I have a bigger flat with a balcony.

script.speaker: kemal
script.text: The only problem is the bus. There's a bus to the city only every two hours.

script.speaker: kemal
script.text: In Istanbul I went everywhere by metro, but here I need a car.

script.speaker: kemal
script.text: People here are very friendly. I know all my neighbours.

script.speaker: kemal
script.text: Sometimes I miss the big city, but I am happier here.

questions.prompt: What is better in Kemal's town than in Istanbul?
questions.feedback: Kasabası daha sessiz ve havası daha temiz (cleaner). Otobüs ve dükkânlar ise az.
questions.evidence: My town is much quieter than Istanbul, and the air is cleaner.

questions.feedback: Her çarşamba (every Wednesday) pazar kuruluyor. "Every two hours" otobüslerin sıklığı.
questions.evidence: there is a nice market every Wednesday.

questions.prompt: What is the problem in the town?
questions.feedback: Şehre otobüs sadece iki saatte bir var; tek sorun bu.
questions.evidence: The only problem is the bus.
